summary: Finished slice 2: documentation for toggle styling (README example, api.md ZestToggleStyle and ToggleOptions.style, configuration.md Toggle Styling, features.md, examples.md Recipe 9, development.md internals, breaking-changes.md 1.8.0 additive) and a documentation test for R10. The earlier attempt's code and tests (types, compile, sheet, hook, button wiring, exports, version 1.8.0) were checked and left unchanged. Build succeeds, tsc is clean, and all 24 suites / 300 tests under __tests__ pass. A repo-wide jest run also picks up stale copies under .devteam/runs/*/scratch which fail on old version asserts; those are not project tests.

tests.name: R1: empty or missing settings compile to nothing
R1: a provider with an empty styles section changes nothing
R1: nested providers use only the inner settings
R1: a plain button inside a styled provider is not styled
R1: a toggle outside any provider has no generated style hook and keeps aria-pressed
R2: kebab-case and camelCase are the same property and are emitted once
R2/R8: an unknown property is passed through but bad values drop only themselves
R2: injection values never reach the page as extra rules, elements or properties
R3: hover looks sit inside a hover-capable media query and exclude disabled
R3: each state gets its own selector; disabled and busy come after on/off
R3/R8: 100 styled toggles share one rule set and leave no style element or timers behind
R4: size, variant and base layer, variant beats size beats base, other properties merge
R4: a toggle whose semantic type supplies the danger variant uses the danger look
R5: theme 'system' follows the operating system theme live
R5: a light-only colour leaves the dark theme at the built-in look
R6: a per-button style changes only that toggle and updates on re-render
R7: heavy styling keeps aria-pressed, click, Space/Enter, the aria-hidden check and no focus override
R8: a replaced config restyles on the next render
R8: a config recreated every render keeps the same id (no flicker)
R8: a hostile config does not unmount the button
R8: equal ids share one rule and it is removed only after the last release
R9: the new types and the existing exports are available from the package entry
R10: the documented example uses settings that exist and produces every documented look
R10: every page that shows the feature links to the toggle styling reference and names the real settings
R10: breaking-changes documents the current package version as additive
